title: Affine derivatives of nonquadratic bent Boolean functions
summary: For even dimension, determine the largest number of distinct affine derivatives of a nonquadratic bent Boolean function.

formal_statement.body: For even $n$, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be bent and nonquadratic, and define $\Delta_a f(x)=f(x+a)+f(x)$. Determine the maximum number of distinct affine functions among the derivatives $\Delta_a f$, equivalently the maximum dimension of $A_f=\{a\in\mathbb F_2^n:\Delta_a f\text{ is affine in }x\}$.

scope.unresolved_remainder: Classification of all extremal functions is outside this record.

citations.label: Carlet, Boolean Functions for Cryptography and Coding Theory

progress.summary: Carlet records the extremal affine-derivative question for nonquadratic bent functions.
